title: Spring simulations estimate velocity with a forward difference
evidence: physics__spring__damping_regimes frame 0: Flutter dx 30 for all regimes; Incular 34.8282 (under), 34.6680 (critical), 34.3399 (over). physics__scroll_spring__snap_when_done frame 0: 0 vs 4.9438. Position stays within tolerance. The incular-scroll spring used by ballistic dispatch is analytic and matches (physics__ballistic_dispatch__bouncing_overscroll_at_rest).
impact: Spring consumers receive a velocity one millisecond ahead of the requested instant; the same value feeds isDone, and direct scroll-spring handoffs inherit the discrepancy.
cause: incular-animation computes velocity as a finite difference over 1 ms instead of Flutter's closed-form derivatives.
fix_direction: Implement the analytic derivative for each damping regime and use it in completion checks.
limitations: Scoped to incular-animation SpringSimulation and ScrollSpringSimulation; the incular-scroll ballistic spring is analytic and matches.

title: Negative acceleration marks gravity simulations done immediately
evidence: Both positions are 0 with an end threshold of 100 at frame 0; Flutter reports done=0, Incular reports done=1.
impact: A negative-acceleration simulation starting below its positive threshold can be treated as finished before it moves.
cause: Completion follows the acceleration direction instead of the absolute distance threshold defined by Flutter.
fix_direction: Compare position.abs() with the nonnegative end threshold for either acceleration sign.

title: Bounded friction changes velocity and omits the bound-distance tolerance
evidence: At clamped x=4 Flutter reports dx 90.8356 and Incular 0. In physics__bounded_friction__distance_tolerance the start is 3.9995 with max 4: Flutter reports done at frame 0 and Incular does not; at frame 1 Flutter dx is 96.8468 and Incular 0.
impact: Consumers lose the simulated velocity at a display bound, and a position already within Flutter's settling tolerance continues in Incular.
cause: Incular treats the bounds as a velocity stop and checks the unclamped position with exact inequalities.
fix_direction: Preserve the inner friction velocity and determine bound completion from the clamped position's distance to each bound using tolerance.distance.
limitations: Distance-tolerance completion is checked at the default 0.001 tolerance only.

title: Clamped simulations cannot clamp velocity
evidence: Non-equivalent diagnostic: Flutter configured with dxMax=50 reports 50 at frame 0; Incular has no velocity-bound option and reports the raw 200. Source review confirms the constructor takes position bounds only.
impact: Callers cannot cap velocity independently from position in the Incular wrapper as Flutter allows.
cause: The Incular constructor models only position limits.
fix_direction: Add optional velocity bounds and clamp the forwarded velocity to them.
limitations: Not a same-configuration comparison; the Incular side cannot express dxMax.

title: Completion is inclusive at Flutter's strict tolerance boundary
evidence: physics__friction__tolerance_boundary uses speed and velocity tolerance both 0.001; done is 0 in Flutter and 1 in Incular at frame 0. physics__spring__tolerance_boundary starts exactly one distance tolerance from equilibrium; Flutter reports not done and Incular reports done at frame 0 (value.spring.done).
impact: A simulation exactly on the tolerance edge can stop one evaluation earlier in Incular.
cause: Inclusive comparisons replace Flutter's strict comparisons.
fix_direction: Use strict comparisons for the same boundary cases, including the nearZero checks used by springs.
limitations: Only exact-boundary inputs are affected; off-boundary completion matches.

title: Spring descriptions normalize inputs Flutter preserves
evidence: A raw description (mass 0, stiffness 0, damping -1) stays unchanged in Flutter and becomes (1, 100, 10) in Incular. A damping ratio of -0.25 gives damping -5 and underdamped in Flutter, damping 20 and critically damped in Incular (value.negative_ratio.damping, value.negative_ratio.type).
impact: Callers using the same spring parameters can get a different solver regime and motion; invalid or unusual values do not keep their Flutter meaning.
cause: Incular adds fallback validation that Flutter's public constructors do not have.
fix_direction: Preserve constructor parameters and let documented validation or the caller govern invalid physical values.
limitations: Only the invalid-input cases listed are checked; valid regimes match.

title: Duration and bounce spring creation retains sub-millisecond precision
evidence: physics__spring_description__duration_bounce passes 300,500 us and bounce 0.3. Flutter reports stiffness 438.6491, damping 29.3215, derived duration 300 ms; Incular reports stiffness 437.1906, damping 29.2727, and derived duration 301 ms.
impact: Sub-millisecond duration values produce slightly different spring timing and damping.
cause: The conversion uses fractional seconds rather than Flutter's millisecond truncation.
fix_direction: Convert the duration to whole milliseconds before computing stiffness if exact Flutter parity is intended.
limitations: Only the sub-millisecond input is tested.

title: Spring description duration and bounce getters are missing
evidence: Source review. The duration/bounce twin reconstructs Flutter's getters in test code because the Incular type has no corresponding methods.
impact: Callers cannot query the perceptual duration or bounce value of an existing spring description through the public API.
cause: Only physical coefficients were modeled in the Rust type.
fix_direction: Add derived duration and bounce accessors with Flutter's formulas and rounding.
limitations: Not a runtime divergence; the formulas are not compared through a public Incular getter.

title: SpringSimulation lacks the snapToEnd option
evidence: Source review. Direct frame twins use Flutter's default snapToEnd=false; Incular has no equivalent configuration for the true case. ScrollSpringSimulation snaps position only (physics.rs:217-231).
impact: Callers cannot request Flutter's endpoint-and-zero-velocity behavior on a general spring simulation.
cause: Endpoint snapping is split into a separate scroll-oriented wrapper.
fix_direction: Add a snap_to_end option that snaps both outputs once is_done is true.
limitations: Not frame-tested because no Incular configuration exists to twin the true case.

title: FrictionSimulation omits Flutter's desktop and endpoint helpers
evidence: Source review. physics__friction__ordinary verifies the shared zero-constant-deceleration curve and matches; constantDeceleration, through, finalX and timeAtX have no Incular counterpart on the animation friction type.
impact: Callers cannot reproduce Flutter's constant-deceleration desktop friction or query motion through known endpoints on the public Incular animation type.
cause: Incular implements only the basic exponential decay in incular-animation; similarly named endpoint behavior exists privately in incular-scroll ballistics.
fix_direction: Expose constant deceleration, a through constructor, final position, and time-at-position on the animation friction type.
limitations: The missing methods are source-only; no runtime comparison is possible.

title: Simulation tolerance cannot be read or changed through the trait
evidence: Source review. The Simulation trait defines position, velocity and completion only. Concrete constructors may accept a tolerance, but generic callers cannot inspect or update it through dyn Simulation.
impact: Code that changes tolerance after construction, or handles heterogeneous simulations through the base interface, cannot be ported directly.
cause: The trait contains evaluation methods but omits shared simulation configuration.
fix_direction: Expose tolerance through the simulation abstraction, with a documented mutable or builder-based update path.
limitations: Source-only; the trait has no tolerance member to exercise.

title: nearEqual and nearZero have no public Incular equivalent
evidence: Source review. rg -n for nearEqual, near_equal and near_zero finds only the private near_zero helper at crates/incular-scroll/src/ballistic.rs:58-60 and no public physics utility.
impact: Callers cannot reuse Flutter's null-aware near-equality and near-zero checks through an Incular physics utility.
cause: The helper was kept local to scroll spring completion rather than exposed as a shared physics utility.
fix_direction: Add public helpers in the animation physics module if parity with Flutter's exported utility surface is required.
